chosen_option.purpose: largest distinct paired sample that fits the ceiling

decision: A_HIGHEST_COVERAGE: the primary question is a paired per-case comparison, so distinct paired units are worth more than repeats of a default-temperature stochastic system; B has the same reservation with half the distinct cases; C leaves two thirds of the affordable sample unused

options.purpose: largest distinct paired sample that fits the ceiling
fewer distinct cases, two repeats each

operational_caps_per_case.off_rationale: one logical call with the protected client's full parse re-attempt allowance (3 attempts); transport retries count inside the cap
operational_caps_per_case.on_rationale: 1.77x the Study 1 all-in request rate per case (10.75), covering setting-level phases, Q&A rounds, parse re-attempts and transport retries; exceeding it stops ON with STOPPED_AT_CAP

rules: never start a paired unit unless its full ON+OFF reservation fits; all twelve units are reserved before the first request
one transport retry per request, only for a documented transport/provider failure before valid output; a valid but undesirable result is never retried
every retry, failed call and parse re-attempt counts against the caps and the ceiling
a failed or incomplete case remains in the evidence and is reported
never stop early because results are favourable or unfavourable
safety_margin_reason: covers any input-token overshoot above the per-request input reserve on the final admitted request

study1_calibration_reference.role: calibration reference for the operational ON cap only; never the upper bound
study1_calibration_reference.source: Study 1 real run receipt (private), figures already published in the Hebrew Study 1 readout

theoretical_on_bound.formula: 82 + 61 x N logical calls at MAX_QA_ROUNDS=10 with every answer route taken, each up to 3 parse attempts
theoretical_on_bound.note: exceeds the ceiling at any N >= 4 under full-output reservation; therefore the enforced ceiling is the per-request guard, and the operational caps decide admission
